witnesses.bounded_scope: Reread the novelty audit independently through EOF.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Read each affected portfolio independently through EOF.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Reread each affected proposal shard independently through EOF.

witnesses.signature: A full proposal-shard display exceeded the model-context projection and became unusable.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Parse every shard through EOF and emit only bounded hashes, schemas, required-field checks, and row summaries.

witnesses.signature: The first bounded parser assumed a nonexistent x1/proposals directory.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Resolve exact proposal shard paths from the immutable tree with a bounded file listing.

witnesses.signature: The first compact proposal parser omitted the actual root key rows and reported zero records.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Inspect root keys, select rows explicitly, and rerun only the projection.

witnesses.signature: The mutation-count projection used rejecting_mutations instead of the actual negative_fixtures field.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Inspect one exact fixture container and count its four array entries per proposal.

witnesses.signature: The first Method Flow projection used generic name and status fields rather than title and witness result.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Project the exact method and witness schema keys and resolve every witness link.

witnesses.signature: The first outcome-ledger summary used disposition and artifacts fields that the ledger does not define.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Inspect one complete row and project outcome, obligations, positive_fixture, and positive_witness.

witnesses.signature: The first skill and runner receipt summary projected generic status and installation fields.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Use the exact receipt fields for quick validation, installation, and accepting or rejecting smoke records.

witnesses.signature: The corrected receipt summary still assumed a nested smoke key named passed and produced null booleans.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Decode the JSON line in stdout_tail and evaluate accepted plus the expected return code.

witnesses.signature: The mutation class histogram projected kind rather than mutation_class.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Recompute only the class histogram from the exact mutation_class field.

witnesses.signature: The first worktree collision-probe wrapper placed a native command and status check inside a report-property expression and failed before execution.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Run the native commit probe first, capture its status in a scalar, then construct the report.

witnesses.signature: The first genuine semantic-novelty preflight quarantined ten generic cross-cutting titles at or above the recovered-neighbor threshold and stopped before artifact materialization.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Inspect the exact nearest neighbors and revise only the affected titles or framing before repeating the bounded novelty dependency.

witnesses.signature: The first nearest-neighbor report could not encode a Māori character through the default Windows console and produced no usable projection.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Emit the already computed bounded projection through explicit UTF-8 stdout.

witnesses.signature: The first post-novelty portfolio projection exposed twenty-one exact-approval rows rather than the frozen twenty-row contract.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Remove the redundant real-instrument acquisition packet already covered by the protected real-instrument gate and recount every category.

witnesses.signature: The test-module apply-patch response exceeded the model display budget, so the first acknowledgement could not establish whether the bounded patch had landed completely.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Inspect the exact literal path, byte and line counts, complete tail, and Python AST before treating the file as materialized.

witnesses.signature: The first read-only overview word-count preflight supplied an incomplete temporary audit projection and stopped on the missing recovered-unique-normalized-titles field without writing phase artifacts.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Construct the in-memory preflight input from the builder's complete declared audit shape and rerun only the word-count dependency.

witnesses.signature: The first exact x1 staged diff-hygiene gate found one trailing space and one extra terminal blank line in the owner validator, so the staged tree earned no gate credit.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Remove only the reported whitespace defects, regenerate the planning-only receipts with this failure retained, and restage the unchanged exact allowlist.

witnesses.signature: The first x1 validator invocation stopped before emitting a receipt because its implementation referenced Counter without importing it; the invocation earns zero validation credit.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Add only the missing collections.Counter import, retain this failure in Method Flow, regenerate the planning receipts, and rerun the failed validator dependency once.

witnesses.signature: The first combined post-x1-push equality wrapper returned no attributable output, so it earned zero lifecycle proof credit.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Recover with isolated local, upstream, tracking, fresh-live, divergence, and clean probes without replaying the combined wrapper.

witnesses.signature: The first x2 proposal-list projection leaked nested Python f-string braces into PowerShell and stopped at parse time without repository mutation.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Replace the shell-sensitive formatted projection with a JSON-only Python scalar projection.

witnesses.signature: The first JSON-only proposal projection assumed a generic focus field that is absent from the committed proposal schema and stopped on KeyError.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Inspect the exact committed row keys, then project semantic_slug and other present fields only.

witnesses.signature: The first read-only x2 evidence-overview preflight measured 977 words, below the declared 1,400-word structural floor, and stopped before artifact materialization.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Expand only the bounded source, admission, correction, workload, and nonconversion explanations, then rerun the in-memory word-count dependency.

witnesses.signature: The first 24-test x2 aggregate earned zero aggregate-pass credit after 22 components passed and two test assertions compared a set directly with the tuple-valued allowed-outcome contract.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Convert the allowed-outcome tuple to a set in only the two failed assertions, retain all 22 successful components without replay, and rerun only those two failed dependencies.

witnesses.signature: The first evidence validator earned zero all-pass credit after 30 of 31 checks passed and the owner manifest exposed one stale delta-manifest hash caused by manifest write ordering.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Preserve the failed validator receipt, exclude the owner and delta manifests from one another's hash domains, rebuild the manifests, and rerun only owner-manifest replay plus affected retention arithmetic.

witnesses.signature: The first isolated owner-manifest recovery proved the owner manifest and retention arithmetic but returned zero recovery credit because its meta-predicate expected 30 aggregate checks instead of the exact 31-check receipt.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Preserve the failed recovery receipt, inspect the immutable failed aggregate cardinality, and correct only the recovery meta-predicate to 31 total and 30 passed.

witnesses.signature: The first check-cardinality inspection used PowerShell's read-only false constant as a variable name and produced an unusable failed-name projection.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Repeat only the bounded projection with a task-specific failedNames scalar and retain the parser/runtime fault at zero credit.

witnesses.signature: The second isolated recovery returned no immediate wrapper output and later state inspection found a zero-credit receipt whose owner-manifest check passed but whose recovery arithmetic still used the prior four truth literals.

witnesses.bounded_scope: Preserve the second failed recovery separately, update only the four current retention literals, and run a third isolated owner-manifest and retention recovery.
